qa_pair.question: Against Vorkath in its post-quest version, how much DPS would the player lose by turning off their active offensive prayer? Answer with the difference rounded to 2 decimals.

Against the monster the player is currently fighting, compare their current weapon with an Abyssal tentacle, a Dragon scimitar and an Abyssal bludgeon (two-handed, so no shield). Which weapon gives the highest DPS? Answer with the weapon name only.
Vorkath exists in two versions in the calculator data. What is the NPC id of the version with more hitpoints?

Against post-quest Vorkath, the player wonders which melee prayer setup is best: Piety, Chivalry, or Ultimate Strength combined with Incredible Reflexes. What is the DPS of the best option, as reported by the calculator (3 decimals)?
If the player had only drunk a Super attack potion (no strength boost) instead of their current boosts, what would their max hit be against an Abyssal demon with their current prayers?
What is the defence level of the monster the player is currently fighting?

Against the player's current target, by how many percentage points does accuracy change if they switch from their current whip style to Flick? Answer rounded to 2 decimals, positive if accuracy goes up.
How many monster entries (all versions counted separately) in the calculator data have "dragon" in their name?
With no prayers active and no potion boosts at all, what would the player's max hit be against an Abyssal demon in their current gear and style?

On a slayer task, if the player wielded an Abyssal tentacle and wore a Slayer helmet (i), keeping everything else the same, what would their average time to kill an Abyssal demon be, in whole seconds?
